title: Language Models Keep Abandoned Analyses: Residue and Adaptation after Garden-Path Sentences
abstract: arXiv:2610.36797v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reading "While the man hunted the deer ran into the woods" requires giving up the analysis in which "the deer" is the object of "hunted". People who have just read such a sentence still produce more transitive structures, so the abandoned analysis primes later language. We ask whether language models keep using an analysis they have abandoned, and what in the model carries it. In 24 open models from 124M to 70B parameters, a garden-path sentence leaves two traces in the context. A residue of the abandoned analysis raises later object attachment, by about three quarters of the effect of a sentence in which the noun phrase really is an object, and it appears in sampled text, on held-out and human-normed items and for a second type of garden path. An adaptation toward the resolved structure scales with the sentence's disambiguation error and acts mainly on comprehension-like measures. Activation patching separates the two. Later text reads

translated_title: 语言模型会保留被放弃的分析：花园路径句之后的残留与适应
translated_abstract: 阅读"While the man hunted the deer ran into the woods"（当那个男人追猎那只鹿跑进了树林）这样的句子，需要放弃将"the deer"（鹿）视为"hunted"（追猎）宾语的分析。刚刚读过这类句子的人仍会产出更多及物结构，说明被放弃的分析会引导（启动）后续语言处理。我们探究语言模型是否会继续使用它们已经放弃的分析，以及模型中是什么承载着这一分析。在从1.24亿到700亿参数的24个开源模型中，花园路径句会在上下文中留下两种痕迹：其一，被放弃分析的残留会提高后续的宾语附着倾向，其效应约为名词短语真正作为宾语的句子效应的四分之三，且该残留出现在采样文本中，在留出测试集和经人类规范化的测试项上同样成立，并对第二类花园路径句也有效；其二，向已消解结构的适应随句子的消歧误差大小而缩放，且主要作用于类似理解的任务度量。激活修补技术将这两种痕迹区分开来。后续文本读……
tldr: 该研究发现，语言模型在处理花园路径句后会留下两种痕迹：被放弃句法分析的残留会提升后续宾语附着倾向（效应约为真实宾语句的四分之三），而向已消解结构的适应随消歧误差缩放并主要影响理解类任务，激活修补技术可将二者区分开来。
en_tdlr: Language models retain a residue of the syntactic analysis they abandoned after garden-path sentences, boosting later object attachment, alongside an adaptation toward the resolved structure that scales with disambiguation error and mainly affects comprehension-like measures, with activation patching separating the two.
